objective: Remove the Spots Activity filter and add the requested Spot-specific vibes and amenities across suggestion, moderation publication, storage, list/detail display, filtering, and map results.
userOutcome: Members can describe new Spots with Spot vibes and amenities, see those values on Spots, and filter both the list and map by them without an Activity filter.
audience: Authenticated cruush members and Spot moderators.
successCriteria: The Activity group is absent from Spot filters.
Spot vibes use a dedicated taxonomy separate from profile vibes.
Amenities are named Amenities in the interface and use the requested Spot amenity taxonomy.
New Spot suggestions can select up to three vibes and any applicable amenities.
Published suggestions persist their vibes and amenities as public Spot data.
Spot filters narrow both drawer results and map markers by selected vibes and amenities.
Spot results and detail surfaces display stored Spot vibes, and detail displays stored amenities.
mustPreserve: Preserve Spot search, sorting, distance, place type, community and care filters, map style, check-ins, boards, ratings, reports, and moderation privacy.
Preserve profile vibe taxonomy without reuse or mutation.
Preserve existing Spots with empty vibe and amenity data rather than fabricating values.
Preserve unrelated user work and the Android top-control sizing correction.
nonGoals: No Crowd fit or demographic Spot filters.
No inferred, fabricated, or appearance-derived Spot data.
No activity-filter replacement under another label.
No tests, build, preview, migration execution, push, or deployment.

assumptions.statement: The requested vibe and amenity values are the newer Spots handoff taxonomy: Chill, Social, Flirty, Cruisy, Dancey, High-energy, Intimate, Community, After-hours, Outdoor, Historical, Exposed; and Restrooms, Drinks, Cover charge, Accessible, Transit nearby, Staff present, Indoor, Outdoor.
assumptions.impact: These values become the dedicated public Spot taxonomy without changing profile vibes.

assumptions.statement: Remove Activity filter means remove the Activity filter group, not the existing Active now and Recent activity sort choices.
assumptions.impact: Members retain sorting while no longer filtering by activity state.

nextVisibleMilestone: Commit the complete Spot vibe and amenity source path as intentionally unverified code.
stopConditions: Stop before tests, build, preview, migration execution, push, deployment, or fabricated data.
